cluster_reason: These three classes form a cohesive iterator-related cluster: IOIterator defines the iterator abstraction, IOIteratorAdapter is a direct adapter implementation tied to IOIterator, and UncheckedIOIterator is a small wrapper that adapts IOIterator semantics for unchecked exceptions. They have strong internal interactions and limited, well-defined external usage, so moving them together isolates iterator concerns without touching unrelated core interfaces like Uncheck or IOStream.

blocks.goal: Move the iterator-related classes (IOIterator, IOIteratorAdapter, UncheckedIOIterator) into a dedicated subpackage to reduce package bloat and improve cohesion.

ops.details: Create the destination subpackage org.apache.commons.io.function.iter to host iterator-related classes.
Move IOIterator to the iterator subpackage to group iterator abstractions separately from other function types.
Move IOIteratorAdapter alongside IOIterator since it is an adapter implementation tightly coupled to the iterator abstraction.
Move UncheckedIOIterator with the iterator cluster because it wraps IOIterator behavior for unchecked exception handling.
